startup: Run from repository root; execute shared CREATE IF NOT EXISTS migration at startup. GET /health checks DB readiness. Reject any MODE other than local. Containers use HOST=0.0.0.0 explicitly.

demo_funding_methods.DEMO_WEBVIEW: PENDING + web_view_user_input_action; requires local demo consent/completion before finalization
demo_funding_methods.DEMO_QR: PENDING + qr_code_input_action; requires local demo completion before finalization

ledger: Charges debit the authenticated synthetic wallet. Payouts debit payer.id settlement account and credit payee.account.account_id only on confirmation; pending payouts reserve payer funds, rejection releases the reservation. Manual charges reserve available; a single full/partial capture debits captured funds and releases all unused hold; decline/cancel/72h expiry releases the original hold. Original manual amount is retained as authorized_e5. Pending refunds reserve refundable amount against the original charge. Network processor calls use the separate durable HTTP executor, never the in-process demo adapter.

responses.charge: 200 state object and psp_reference for all outcomes; MANUAL responds CONFIRMED but stores AUTHORIZED. Manual pending/action rejected400.
responses.capture: 200 empty for one positive full/partial capture up to authorization; unused hold released. excess400 EXCEEDS_CAPTURE_LIMIT; wrong currency400; invalid/closed authorization409; hard/soft decline422 releases full hold without debit.
responses.findTransaction: 200 id/merchant_reference/status/amount by Uber ID; CANCELLED is an explicit additive reference runtime extension (U4), including expiry.
responses.refund: 201 status CONFIRMED/PENDING/REJECTED + merchant_reference; partial allowed to captured amount; pending based on original funding method DEMO_PENDING*; original unknown404
responses.payout: 200 CONFIRMED/PENDING without actions; initial insufficient funds400; invalid-account400 INVALID_PAYMENT_DETAILS_ERROR; documented synthetic payee declines422; conflicting ID/key409. See demo-outcomes.json.
responses.balance: 200 available_balance + balance; signature AND bearer get_balance always required
responses.errors: Operation-specific declared errors; empty body where no content declared. Unexpected/transient failures return500 on ALL routes (accepted reference U3 deviation), never400 and never persisted. Same key/changed payload returns400 except payout409 DUPLICATE_REQUEST_ERROR. Auth401 only where declared, otherwise400; token invalid signature ->400 invalid_request. Undeclared4xx are forbidden.

idempotency: Required for charge,capture,cancel,initRefund,payout. operations PK(client_id,operation_name,idem_key), canonical sorted-key exact-integer request hash incl resource path. Default local fake ledger/idempotency uses a per-client PG transaction advisory lock; HTTP mode uses short operation/resource/account reservations, no remote calls under locks; lock_timeout1500ms and statement_timeout5000ms bound local waiting. Duplicate transaction create ID+samepayload returns saved original response even with new key; different payload400 (payout409). 2xx/nonretryable4xx replay; do not persist5xx; auth before replay. OAuth grants atomic single-use, not money idempotency.

signature.payload:
(request-target): lowercase-method raw-path-with-query
host: exact Host
date: exact Date
digest: exact Digest
signature.digest: SHA-256=base64(sha256(raw bytes)); empty bytes for GET
signature.verify: strict bounded params; keyId configured; algorithm exact; signed headers exact; no duplicate params; Date within configured skew; constant-time digest; no request logging of sensitive headers; IMF-fixdate only; optional quoted created/expires impose additional freshness/expiry bounds and do not extend signed Date validity.

oauth.authorize: GET renders local-only explicit consent HTML, no auto grant; validate client,response_type,redirect_uri,scope,state,authorization_details JSON array. Consent POST /demo/consent (outside BASE_PATH) uses CSRF token to issue code+redirect echo state; fake identity demo-account local only. Validate/display funding method, country, scopes and locale; persist consent context through grants. English/Portuguese demo only, not real login/SCA.
oauth.token: POST signed JSON validates CLIENT_ID/SECRET. authorization_code -> refresh_token,token_type lowercase bearer,authorization_details; refresh_token -> access_token,token_type bearer,expires_in STRING; wallet custom grant -> refresh_token,token_type bearer,authorization_details. Runtime response validated by grant-selected schema because upstream response oneOf branches overlap.
oauth.tokens: Hashed tokens only. Code10min single use bound to client/redirect/scopes/account; reused code revokes issued family. Access600sec. Reusable refresh tokens have configurable REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS default2592000; no rotation by accepted U2 policy. Scopes charge/refund/get_balance/offline_access; refresh never accepted as bearer.
oauth.enforcement: OAUTH_REQUIRED=true requires bearer for charge/capture/cancel/refund. AccessTokenAuthorization always requires bearer and matching account; webview signature-only allowed unless OAUTH_REQUIRED. Balance always scoped bearer.

jobs: COMPLETION jobs finalize pending transaction+ledger+CALLBACK job in same PG transaction, stable IDs include client/kind/tx. Webview/QR initially WAITING until consent/test complete. Worker claims via lease or SKIP LOCKED and retries after restart. CALLBACK jobs attempt network outside DB lock, token cache by scope, renew expires_in with min(60s,10%) margin; 401 evicts token and schedules bounded retry with unchanged event key; retry429/5xx/timeouts with bounded backoff; 409->RECONCILE, other permanent4xx/exhaustion->FAILED; acknowledgment only2xx. Every delivery uses stable key where declared. No duplicate side effects on retry. Callback identity includes monotonic transaction sequence; later versions wait until earlier callbacks are DONE. Unknown/permanent earlier delivery remains inspectable and blocks later events. HTTP mode uses PROVIDER_WAIT, never synthetic completion timers.

test_control.guard: Only ENABLE_TEST_CONTROL=true and nonempty random TEST_CONTROL_SECRET; X-Test-Control-Secret required; outside BASE_PATH under /_test; disabled default
test_control.GET /_test/state: JSON accounts/transactions/jobs synthetic data, no token hashes or secrets
test_control.POST /_test/expire: {id} expires authorized charge through normal release logic
test_control.POST /_test/callback: {name,id,payload} queues one of six typed callbacks for contract tests
test_control.POST /_test/reverse-refund: {id} invokes idempotent synthetic refund inverse and ordered rejected update; disabled by default.

safety: Outbound hosts allowed only localhost,127.0.0.1,::1,mock-uber,processor in local mode; refuse userinfo and redirects. Nonlocal MODE fails startup. No production serving mode; real PSP/wallet adapters and security review required for sandbox. Never claim actual Uber qualification from local tests.
actions: Generate a 256-bit unguessable capability when creating a WAITING charge; GET never mints authority from an Uber ID. POST requires capability+CSRF+unexpired WAITING job; single-use across races. ACTION_TTL_MS defaults10min and is the QR expiry. User deny ->USER_CANCELLED; expiry ->MERCHANT_EXPIRED; both release hold and queue rejection. Redirect only to exact ALLOWED_REDIRECT_URIS; no redirect for an unregistered return_url.
limitations: No real-money processor, resource-owner authentication, production serving mode, automatic production retention/erasure or real-counterparty settlement acceptance.
Balance uses the synthetic ledger; real KYC/routing/conversion, security and financial controls must be supplied by a PSP.
The shared suite includes versioned JSON workflows plus Python orchestration for deterministic processor and multiworker faults; not every test is a JSON scenario.
processor_executor: Optional native local HTTP executor: encrypted durable command+configuration hash, stable provider key, resource/debit/credit reservations, prepare -> HTTP outside SQL -> fenced finalization. Poll or authenticated versioned /adapter/events; uncertain outcome retains reservations and returns retryable500, never a cached5xx. Independent fixture and protocol are reference-only; real modes remain disabled.
funding_profiles: reference-features.json owns synthetic profiles/reasons and en-US/pt-BR copy. FUNDING_METHODS_FILE maps an assigned alias to a demo profile with explicit countries/currencies. Configuration cannot change while intents are outstanding. This is not Uber registration.
refund_reversal: CONFIRMED -> REJECTED: unique inverse record, recover only unreserved funds, record unrecovered debt, preserve unrelated holds; future credits/releases repay debt before spendability. Ordered event sequences prevent callback overtaking. Synthetic reference accounting policy, not Uber approval.

enum_applicability.OAuth2Error.unauthorized_client: Not emitted by the single registered local client, which is enabled for all three declared grants. A multi-client PSP must add grant authorization policy.
enum_applicability.OAuth2Error.unsupported_token_type: Revocation-only code; there is no token-revocation operation in this pinned API surface.

reference_decision_status: U1-U15 accepted by delegated reference-project design authority; not upstream certification.
settlement: Accepted reference U15: immutable commit-time journal, closed UTC daily periods (or explicit closed library windows), canonical per-source JSONL with decimal-string E5 and per-currency totals, sealed checksummed manifest, no overlapping batches, idempotent atomic directory or pinned-host-key local SFTP publication outside SQL. Delivery receipt is not financial acceptance. See contracts/settlement-reference.schema.json and docs/settlement.md.
runtime_extensions: U4: /find-transaction status enum includes CANCELLED in derived runtime only; unchanged upstream pin and hash remain authoritative evidence of the published source.
